title: INTRODUCTION TO THEORY OF COMPUTATION
description: Survey of models of computation including finite automata, formal grammars, and Turing machines.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CS 261 or 261H and (CS 225, MTH 231 or 231H).
A minimum grade of C is required in CS 261, CS 261H, CS 225, MTH 231 and MTH 231H.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Elect & Computer Engineering (039) or Computer Science (307).

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
